title: Hazardous
description: Hazardous is a very configurable mod that adds hazards (like radiation, poison, ...) to your world. It's meant for modpack makers who want to spice up the world under certain conditions
body:
Hazardous is a mod that allows a modpack maker to add hazards (poison, radiation, ...) to your world based on various conditions. It adds various items to help and combat those hazards and is extremely configurable. Check out this link for more documentation: 

[Hazardous Documentation](https://github.com/McJtyMods/Hazardous/blob/main/docs/datapack.md)

Thanks to TqLxQuanZ who asked for this mod for his DeceasedCraft modpack! He also contributed all of the assets (sounds and artwork)
